description: "Round About a Great Estate" by Richard Jefferies is a literary work that can be categorized as a nature-focused memoir or descriptive essay, written in the late 19th century. The text reflects on rural life, the changing countryside, and the connection between humans and nature, presumably drawing from Jefferies' own experiences in England.
